description: Only what Dependabot cannot see: Helm chart versions in Argo CD Applications under deploy/, and the Argo CD chart version in the bootstrap script. Everything else is Dependabot's (.github/dependabot.yml).

customManagers.description: The Argo CD chart that deploy/bootstrap/bootstrap.sh installs; must equal targetRevision in deploy/platform/argocd.yaml (make deploy-lint checks).

packageRules.description: Bootstrap script and Argo CD Application move together, in one PR.
One weekly PR for the other charts; majors on their own.
